source_title: Maruti Suzuki EV exports cross over 50,000 units - Autocar India
source_excerpt:
Maruti Suzuki India has exported more than 50,000 electric vehicles since beginning international shipments in August 2025. The company exports its Made-in-India electric vehicles to about 50 countries, with Europe being its largest export market.
Maruti accounted for 93 percent of India’s EV exports in H1 FY2027.
The brand's EVs are exclusively produced at its Hansalpur facility in Gujarat.
EVs exported to nearly 50 countries; Europe largest destination.
The company said it accounted for nearly 93 percent of India’s EV exports in April–September 2026, according to data from the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM). Maruti Suzuki also ranked as India’s largest electric vehicle exporter in FY2025-26 and retained that position during the first half of FY2026-27.
Maruti Suzuki’s Hansalpur plant is the exclusive manufacturing base for its EVs. The facility recently expanded its annual production capacity to 1 million vehicles, making it the first Suzuki manufacturing facility to reach that capacity at a single location.
Maruti Suzuki exports its all-electric e Vitara mid-size SUV from its Hansalpur plant. Additionally, the plant also manufactures and exports its badge-engineered sibling, the Toyota Urban Cruiser Ebella . The former is priced at Rs 15.99 lakh and Rs 19.99 lakh, while the latter is priced at Rs 23.6 lakh. A 49kWh and 61kWh battery pack is utilised by the e Vitara, whereas the Ebella is sold only with the latter. The e Vitara is shipped to international markets, including the UK, Norway, Germany, Japan and Switzerland.
